mapper.sql: boms.id AS id, boms.code AS code, boms.date AS `date`, boqs.id AS boqId, boqs.code AS boqCode, (SELECT pc_code FROM project_costings WHERE boq_id = boqs.id AND status = 2) AS pcCode, boms.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, customers.id AS organizationId, customers.customer_code AS organizationCode, customers.name AS organizationName, customer_contacts.id AS organizationContactId, customer_contacts.contact_name AS organizationContact, boms.note AS note, boms.total_cost AS totalCost, boms.total_price AS totalPrice, (SELECT so_code FROM sales_orders WHERE sales_orders.bom_id = boms.id AND status > 0 ORDER BY sales_orders.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS invoiceNo, (SELECT DATEDIFF(sales_orders.order_date, boms.approved) FROM sales_orders WHERE sales_orders.bom_id = boms.id AND status > 0 ORDER BY sales_orders.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS invoiceDateDiff, boms.status AS status, boms.approved AS approved, CONCAT(approver.first_name, ' ', approver.last_name) AS approvedBy, boms.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy

FROM boms LEFT JOIN boqs ON boqs.id = boms.boq_id LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = boms.company_id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = boms.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = boms.customer_contact_id LEFT JOIN users AS approver ON approver.id = boms.approved_by LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = boms.created_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boms ( `date`, company_id, boq_id, customer_id, customer_contact_id, note, total_cost, total_price, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{bom.date}, #{bom.companyId}, #{bom.boqId}, #{bom.organizationId}, #{bom.organizationContactId}, #{bom.note}, #{bom.totalCost}, #{bom.totalPrice}, NOW(), #{bom.createdBy}, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT bom_details.type_id AS `type`, bom_details.id AS id, bom_details.product_id AS productId, CASE WHEN type_id IN (2,3) THEN bom_details.description ELSE products.name END AS productName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, bom_details.qty AS qty, IFNULL(products.small_val_uom,1) / IFNULL(bom_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, bom_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, bom_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, bom_details.total_cost AS totalCost, bom_details.unit_price AS unitPrice, bom_details.total_price AS totalPrice, bom_details.remark AS remark FROM bom_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = bom_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = bom_details.qty_uom_id WHERE bom_details.bom_id = #{bomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bom_details ( bom_id, type_id, product_id, description, qty, conversion, qty_uom_id, unit_cost, total_cost, unit_price, total_price, remark ) VALUES ( #{detail.bomId}, #{detail.type}, #{detail.itemId}, #{detail.itemName}, #{detail.qty}, #{detail.conversion}, #{detail.uomId}, #{detail.unitCost}, #{detail.totalCost}, #{detail.unitPrice}, #{detail.totalPrice}, #{detail.remark} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE boms SET status = #{status},
is_approve = 1,
is_approve = 0,
approved = NOW(), approved_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status > 0;
